The final rerun mean is distinct from the selected checkpoint score above. Updated documentation adds the RoboJuDo-Plus SuperMimic deployment route; the authors report 23DoF G1 hardware use, with velocity tracking still in development. Source snapshot.

- A from-scratch mjlab implementation for G1, with Chinese reproduction notes, LAFAN1/BONES-SEED processing, multi-GPU training, an interactive replay viewer and a released full-data checkpoint.

On LAFAN1, anchor-relative observations reach 0.904, 3 / 40 failures, while paper observations reach 0.56–0.59, 3–9 / 40 across three runs.
- Useful context: BONES-SEED clips are short (median 5.8 seconds), whereas paper-observation policies drift on 100–300-second LAFAN1 clips. The two observation settings are not directly comparable. The upstream README pairs 0.930 with the filtered failure count; the set-specific figures above follow the experiment log. Source snapshot.

The two results have different evaluation setups. Rendering uses known scene meshes, not unknown real environments. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. Source snapshot.
